post.summary: Merge departments into one
post.description: Moves everything filed under the `mergeIds` departments to `keepId` and deletes them. Questions that become the same exam are combined (papers, saves and views move to one). Courses with the same name in the merged departments are combined too. With `dryRun`, only reports what would move.

post.summary: Merge courses into one
post.description: Moves everything filed under the `mergeIds` courses to `keepId` and deletes them. Questions that become the same exam are combined (papers, saves and views move to one). The courses must be in the same department. With `dryRun`, only reports what would move.

422.description: Invalid fields, or courses of different departments

post.summary: Merge semesters into one
post.description: Moves everything filed under the `mergeIds` semesters to `keepId` and deletes them. Questions that become the same exam are combined (papers, saves and views move to one). With `dryRun`, only reports what would move.

post.summary: Merge exam types into one
post.description: Moves everything filed under the `mergeIds` exam types to `keepId` and deletes them. Questions that become the same exam are combined (papers, saves and views move to one). With `dryRun`, only reports what would move.

post.summary: Count a question page view
post.description: Public and unauthenticated. Counts only views sent from the question's page: `viewToken` from `GET /questions/{id}` in `X-View-Token`, from a browser or app rather than a crawler or script. A token counts each page at most once a minute, and a browser once a day. Other requests are ignored, still with 204.

204.description: Counted, or ignored as not a visitor's view
